description: This file declares macros, external functions, and includes for managing Green Ethernet and power-saving features on the RTL8367C switch chip, serving as part of the high-level API.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicGreenTrafficType
methods.description: Sets the green traffic type for a given priority.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicGreenTrafficType
methods.description: Retrieves the green traffic type for a given priority.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicGreenPortPage
methods.description: Gets the page information for a specific port related to green Ethernet.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicGreenHighPriorityTraffic
methods.description: Gets indication of high priority green traffic on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicGreenHighPriorityTraffic
methods.description: Configures high priority green traffic on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicGreenEthernet
methods.description: Enables or disables green Ethernet on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicGreenEthernet
methods.description: Retrieves the green Ethernet status on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPowerSaving
methods.description: Enables or disables power saving mode for a PHY.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPowerSaving
methods.description: Checks if power saving mode is enabled for a PHY.
